a16z crypto: 5 Ways Blockchains Help AI Agents

title: Blockchains govern AI-run systems by recording decisions onchain and verifying execution with cryptographic proofs
content:
When AI systems coordinate resources, they create dependency layers that need governing. a16z crypto argues blockchains enable this by recording collective decisions onchain and executing them automatically, ensuring agents follow verified outcomes rather than operator discretion.

**Verification dimension:** cryptographic proofs can attest to training data, prompts, and execution logs — and prevent providers from secretly retraining models out from under their users.

**Why it matters:** governance of autonomous systems can't rely on human-speed oversight; it has to be embedded in the substrate the agents transact on.

Source: a16z crypto, "5 Ways Blockchains Can Help AI Agents" (https://a16zcrypto.com/posts/article/5-ways-blockchains-help-ai-agents/).
